description: This Swift source file defines the 'TerminationSignalWatcher' class, responsible for listening to system termination signals (SIGTERM and SIGINT), handling graceful shutdown procedures such as stopping pairing prompts and terminating the app.

classes.name: TerminationSignalWatcher
classes.description: A singleton class that manages system signal handling for graceful application termination.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes signal handlers for SIGTERM and SIGINT if not already installed.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Removes all signal sources and resets termination flags.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Sets up a signal source for a specific signal and attaches an event handler.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles incoming termination signals by stopping pairing prompts and terminating the app.
